headline: Six. The dark is thinning.
body: Ten degrees under a mostly clear sky, wind near fourteen from the west. The streets stay empty and dry; lamps still hold the only light. Civil dawn is about forty minutes off.

pulses.value: mostly clear, 10°C, wind near 14 mph west

pulses.value: six; about forty minutes to civil dawn
